Metrics documentation for Firedancer tiles and link counters.

# Purpose
This file defines the metric names, types, and descriptions used by many tiles in the system, and it serves as a reference for runtime observability data. Each section groups related counters, gauges, and histograms for one tile, such as `net`, `quic`, `pack`, `bank`, `gossip`, and `snapshot`, so operators can track network flow, transaction handling, scheduling, replay, and snapshot work. The entries also define label values for metrics that report different outcomes, states, or error classes, which lets monitoring tools split the data into clear categories. In the codebase, this content supports consistent metric naming and documentation across the validator pipeline and its service stages.
